prompts.design: Isolated flat print artwork for a ceramic mug, centered on a plain solid pure white canvas. The design consists only of a simple minimalist blue line art botanical plant drawing next to large bold clear uppercase text that says exactly "ALEX". No other elements, no borders, no shadows, no extra text, no logos, no artifacts.
prompts.mockup: Lifestyle product mockup of a matte white ceramic mug sitting on a neutral light surface, the mug is facing directly toward the camera so the full print is completely visible. The print on the mug matches the flat design exactly: simple blue botanical line drawing plus large readable "ALEX" text. Soft natural daylight, clean uncluttered background, no extra objects or text in the frame.
prompts.video: 5 second silent vertical 9:16 TikTok product showcase of the ceramic mug. Slow smooth subtle pan across the mug keeping the printed side facing the camera the entire time. The mug artwork is consistent across all frames: simple blue botanical line drawing, large clearly readable "ALEX" text. No overlays, no on-screen text, no music, no sound, plain neutral background.

report.summary: The submission passes all requirements for the video deliverables, including consistent artwork, silent vertical format, and no extra content. However, the required isolated flat print artwork was submitted incorrectly as a composite mug render with floating displaced text, and the static lifestyle mockup also contains a rendering error with oversized text floating outside the mug boundary, instead of the print being applied directly to the mug surface. The artwork content itself (blue botanical drawing + ALEX text) is correct across all assets.
